data.current_description: Run an adaptive company-intelligence query. A successful response is a Server-Sent Events stream. Known events are `status`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `text`, `sources` (source name, link, nullable source update date and check time), `suggested_actions`, terminal `done`, and terminal `error`; clients must ignore unknown event types for forward compatibility. This endpoint requires an active CompanyProof evaluation or paid entitlement and a `cp_live_` key. One accepted stream consumes one shared credit.
data.description_suggestion: Run an adaptive company-intelligence query that streams results as Server-Sent Events. The request accepts a natural-language query about a company. The response stream emits events including: `status` (query progress), `tool_call` and `tool_result` (intermediate reasoning steps), `text` (intelligence findings), `sources` (evidence with name, link, and optional update metadata), `suggested_actions` (recommended follow-up queries), and terminal `done` or `error` events. Clients must ignore unknown event types for forward compatibility. This endpoint requires an active CompanyProof evaluation or paid entitlement and a `cp_live_` key. One accepted stream consumes one shared credit.

One claim credit is reserved per claim. `cp_test_` keys are restricted to the documented CompanyProof sandbox sample; `cp_live_` keys can resolve eligible live company records. data.summary_suggestion: Verify or extract company claims with optional monitoring
data.description_suggestion: Verify structured company claims against resolved company records or extract supported claims from natural-language text. Accepts either pre-structured claims or unstructured text for claim extraction. Returns claim verification results with evidence and verification status. One claim credit is reserved per verified claim. Optional monitoring can be enabled to track claim status over time (requires eligible plan and `cp_live_` key). `cp_test_` keys are restricted to the documented CompanyProof sandbox sample; `cp_live_` keys can resolve eligible live company records. Successful verification may create a durable claim-verification proof.
